Description: Offensive fire magic: fast bursts, delayed eruption fields and one enormous compressed blast. Highest raw damage; weakest control.
Water and ice magic: knockback jets, freezing prisons and the storm-calling Cumulonimbus that makes water casting cheaper. The control element.
Earth magic: stone projectiles, mud fields and raised walls. Rewards positioning and patience; the school of Stone Cannon and Quagmire.
Wind magic: very fast blades, a directional gale dash and a whirlwind that shoves weak foes and deflects projectiles. The mobility element.
